entities.name: Nelly Borca
entities.description: A Boros human detective of the Wojek League from Ravnica, seconded to the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations.

entities.name: Bell Borca
entities.description: Nelly's uncle, a Boros sergeant who solved his own murder after he died.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Ravnican guild Nelly joined as a Wojek sergeant.

entities.name: Wojek League
entities.description: The Boros police branch Nelly serves in.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: Agency with which Nelly coordinates on secondment.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in whose aftermath Nelly volunteered for the posting.

events.summary: Inspired by tales of Bell Borca, Nelly joins the Boros Legion as a Wojek sergeant.
events.quote: which inspired her to join the Boros Legion as a Wojek sergeant

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion Nelly volunteers for a secondment to the Agency of Magicological Investigations.
